```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>", 
  eval = FALSE
)
```

The data for this application is stored in the SQLite database: `inst/extdata/movies.db`.

```{r setup, eval=TRUE}
library(shinydb)
```

Importing the data into the application can be done using the `db_con()` and `join_movies_tbls()` functions.

```{r all_movies, eval=TRUE}
con <- db_con("shinydb", "movies.db")
all_movies <- join_movies_tbls(con = con)
dplyr::glimpse(all_movies)
```

The joined data in `all_movies` contains both tables in `inst/extdata/movies.db`:

```{r close-con, eval=FALSE}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con) # close connection
```
